races.paceDynamic: Institute is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate a sustainable pace without pressure from the field. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses (Skydance, Thundering On, Justiciar, Indomiknow) and several prominent racers (Forty Six A, Purely, Sands Castle), there will be a bunched field tracking Institute through steady early fractions. The lack of pace pressure means Institute can control the tempo, but the large contingent of closers will create a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs as they all try to make their moves simultaneously. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to the pace to avoid traffic problems but have the tactical speed to quicken before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Institute maintains an uncontested lead through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets first run on the field while the large pack of hold-up horses gets caught flat-footed by the change of pace. Prominent racers like Forty Six A and the Ballydoyle pair benefit from their forward positions and tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and multiple closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly in the final furlong with Skydance and Thundering On leading the charge. Their superior ratings and finishing kicks overcome the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Several well-fancied closers get blocked or forced wide, allowing a horse with a clearer passage to capitalize. The winner emerges from those who avoid the scrimmaging rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced fillies shows significant improvement from their debut
scenarios.body: Beatific or another Ballydoyle newcomer produces a professional performance to outclass this modest maiden field. The O'Brien team's superior preparation and jockeyship proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Institute must be watched for market support as the only proven front-runner who can control this race from pillar to post
Skydance carries the highest official rating but the 210-day absence raises questions about readiness for this return
Ryan Moore choosing Purely over stablemate Beatific suggests the blinkers-wearing filly is preferred by connections
The hold-up horses Thundering On, Justiciar and Indomiknow all face traffic concerns in a 16-runner field
Watch for late support for the Ballydoyle newcomers Beatific and any debut runners showing market confidence

races.paceDynamic: Romantic War is the only confirmed front-runner in this 23-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms uncontested through the early stages. With prominent runners like Sedro Woolley, Searcog, and Rock Etoile likely to track him, the pace should be sustainable rather than breakneck over the opening 6 furlongs. The large field creates a cavalry charge scenario in the final 2 furlongs as 20+ hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handy and avoid the traffic chaos, while hold-up horses face a nightmare draw with limited opportunities to deliver their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners track Romantic War at a sensible gallop and kick clear before the cavalry charge
scenarios.body: Searcog, Sedro Woolley and Rock Etoile avoid the traffic mayhem behind and have first run on the tiring leader. The hold-up brigade get caught in a wall of horses with nowhere to go in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Romantic War Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Romantic War gets soft fractions and the prominent trackers don't pressure him early enough
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear at the 2f pole while the field is still scrimmaging for position behind. His stamina reserves prove sufficient to hold off the late charge from traffic-delayed closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and clear runs appear down the outside or up the rail
scenarios.body: One of the McGuinness runners like Comfort Line or Heart Of Darkness times their run to perfection through a gap. The prominent runners pay for following a crawling pace and get swamped late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Longshot
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or severe interference opens up the race for a complete outsider
scenarios.body: The pace and positioning plans go out the window as incidents create gaps for unfancied runners. A horse like Clifftop or Darwin's Angel capitalizes on the mayhem to steal victory.

watchPoints.text: Romantic War must be monitored for early pace - if he goes too fast he'll crack, if too slow he becomes sitting duck

races.paceDynamic: Walhaan will control the early tempo as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable pace with no pressure from the large field of hold-up horses and prominent runners. Sonoran, Va Va Vroom, Fixation, Vega's Muse and Faoladh will track behind but none are aggressive pace pressers. The massive field of 18 runners with predominantly hold-up tactics creates a compressed finish where positioning and traffic will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and early positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Walhaan sets controlled fractions and the prominent runners secure good positions tracking behind
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses creates a bottleneck in the straight as they all seek racing room simultaneously. Prominent runners like Sonoran, Va Va Vroom, Fixation and Vega's Muse enjoy clear runs and kick clear of the traffic-bound field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or the field spreads out more than expected in the straight
scenarios.body: A well-positioned hold-up horse with tactical speed gets a clean run through while others are stuck behind beaten horses. The class and recent form of runners like Syzygy or Merlin The Wizard proves decisive with a clear passage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Maintains
scenarios.trigger: If Walhaan gets soft fractions and the field comes too late to catch him
scenarios.body: The veteran 10-year-old uses his experience to dictate terms from the front, while the large field behind struggles to organize a coherent challenge. Walhaan's recent third at the Curragh shows he retains enough ability when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If extreme traffic problems develop with runners switching wide and bumping in the straight
scenarios.body: The 18-runner field becomes a complete lottery as multiple horses are hampered, stopped, and forced to switch lines. An outsider who gets a dream run up the rail or finds space others cannot benefits from the mayhem.

races.paceDynamic: Flushing Meadows and Iron Lily will contest the early lead, with Iron Lily likely more committed to making all from her last-time-out front-running victory. The supporting cast of prominent runners (Geryon, Power Blue, Dorset, Warsaw, Trojan Warrior, Thesecretadversary) creates significant depth behind the leaders, ensuring sustained pressure throughout. With only two hold-up horses (The Publican's Son, Redemption Road) in an 11-runner field, the pace will be honest but not frantic. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike in the final 2f, as they avoid the scramble for positions while staying close enough to capitalise when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set a solid but not suicidal pace through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect tow before launching their challenges in the final 2f, with the leaders vulnerable late. Power Blue and Dorset are best positioned to capitalise from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Iron Lily or Flushing Meadows can dictate fractions and see off challenges
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run on their rivals and has enough left to hold off late challengers in the testing ground. Either leader could prove too determined for the prominent pack.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early with leaders and prominent runners going too hard
scenarios.body: The Publican's Son gets a perfect setup with plenty of pace collapse ahead of him. His hold-up style thrives when others have overcooked it up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Mumhan has trained on significantly from his debut win and handles the step up
scenarios.body: The Jim Bolger-trained colt catches rivals napping with unexposed ability. His unraced style makes him hard to assess but dangerous if forward enough.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and the prominent brigade gets locked in traffic
scenarios.body: The pace will crack approaching the 2f pole, allowing closers with clean runs to sweep past tiring leaders. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed will benefit most from the setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If True Love and Suzie Songs can secure good positions behind the leaders without getting trapped
scenarios.body: The class fillies can kick clear from prominent positions when the pace steadies, using their superior ratings. Quality prominent racers avoid the early burn and traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Black Caviar Gold dictates fractions and gets a breather mid-race with the prominent horses failing to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The leader can control the tempo and kick again, especially given her proven 7f form and recent wins at the trip. A tactical front-running performance rewards the pace-setter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go suicidally fast and the prominent horses get into an early battle
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the closers in a dramatic finish with wild sectionals. The race becomes a pure stamina test favouring patient tactics.

The prominent brigade of Endorsement, Shosholoza, Christmas Day, and Pierre Bonnard will create congestion behind the leaders, potentially causing traffic problems entering the straight. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable shuffle, as the dual pace-setters lack the class to sustain their gallop against this field.

scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If James J Braddock gets an uncontested lead with South Island disappointing
scenarios.body: The O'Brien second-string can dictate fractions and hold off the closers despite his moderate rating. The prominent horses will be caught between following or making their own pace.

runners_data.name: Cape Cod
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest rating returning from 183-day break under Ryan Moore for in-form Ballydoyle team

runners_data.name: Madbadanddangerous
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but hasn't raced for 182 days, though Oisin Murphy booking suggests stable confidence

runners_data.name: Cherry Hill Girl
runners_data.note: Freshest runner having raced just 21 days ago, prominent style should see her well-placed throughout

runners_data.name: Marjorie Daw
runners_data.note: Returns from 174-day absence but trainer Joseph Murphy has poor recent strike-rate

runners_data.name: Extravagant
runners_data.note: Another Ballydoyle runner returning from long break, prominent style but lower topspeed figure than stablemate

runners_data.name: Pierre Grosse
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing strong pace to be effective, trainer Mrs Harrington without a winner in past 14 days

runners_data.name: So Must I
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in good recent form including a course win last time at 10 furlongs

runners_data.name: Another Day Done
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner but carry less weight and showed best RPR figure, needs pace to develop

races.paceDynamic: Cape Cod looks the most natural early leader with his prominent style and class advantage, likely to dictate terms from the front. Madbadanddangerous and Cherry Hill Girl should track close behind, with Extravagant and Marjorie Daw also seeking forward positions. The hold-up horses Pierre Grosse, So Must I and Another Day Done will need the pace to develop strongly to get their finishing kicks in effectively. This setup favours the prominent/tracking horses who can sit close to Cape Cod without having to do too much early work, as the genuine hold-up brigade may find insufficient pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Measured Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Cape Cod sets a controlled tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get an easy lead and can quicken when it matters most. Hold-up horses find insufficient pace to unleash their finishing kicks effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners challenge Cape Cod early and create stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased pace brings the hold-up horses into play as the early leaders tire. So Must I and Pierre Grosse can use their finishing kicks to good effect.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Cape Cod Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Cape Cod's class advantage tells and he controls the race from pillar to post
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle runner uses his superior rating to dictate completely and kicks clear when ready. The rest are left fighting for minor honours behind the winner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Benefit From Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard early and come back dramatically in final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up horses pay dividends as they sweep past tiring leaders. Pierre Grosse and So Must I emerge from the pack with strong late runs.

watchPoints.text: Cape Cod's 183-day absence could leave him short of peak fitness despite his class advantage
Pierre Grosse and So Must I need the prominent runners to go fast enough early to bring their finishing kicks into play
Madbadanddangerous represents the Noel Meade yard which has been among the winners recently
Another Day Done carries 17 pounds less than Cape Cod which could prove significant over this trip
Cherry Hill Girl's recent run just 21 days ago gives her a fitness edge over most rivals returning from breaks
